veranderings.voor: Hulle koop dit of hulle verbou dit self.
veranderings.na: Hulle koop dit, of hulle verbou dit self.
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'of' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.voor: So begin baie van die kos wat ons koop by 'n boer.
veranderings.na: So begin baie van die kos wat ons koop, by 'n boer.
veranderings.rede: Without a comma after the relative clause the sentence reads as 'the food we buy from a farmer'; the comma closes the clause so 'by 'n boer' attaches to 'begin'.
'daarby' and 'ook' both mean 'in addition', so one is redundant and the sentence reads more smoothly with only 'ook'.
AWS 2017: the part after 'maar' has no subject of its own (it shares 'n Kosversamelaar), so no comma goes before 'maar'.

veranderings.voor: Dit beteken hulle kan mense of diere siek maak of skade doen as dit in die liggaam kom, soos wanneer dit geëet word.
veranderings.na: Dit beteken dat hulle mense of diere siek kan maak of skade kan doen as hulle in die liggaam kom, soos wanneer hulle geëet word.
veranderings.rede: The sentence refers to the same plants, berries and mushrooms first as 'hulle' and then as 'dit'; one pronoun throughout, with 'dat' and the verbs at the end, makes it correct and clear.

veranderings.voor: Daarom moet iemand wat kos versamel die plante baie goed ken.
veranderings.na: Daarom moet iemand wat kos versamel, die plante baie goed ken.
veranderings.rede: A comma after the embedded relative clause stops 'versamel die plante' from being read together as verb and object.
